The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Bangladesh & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from north Coastal Andhra Pradesh to northeast Uttar Pradesh across Odisha and Chhattisgarh at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.

The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Konkan & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
